what: DA3's raytun3r row -- fit + eval, all three methods (vanilla/center_ph/raytun3r), ScanNet++ 3f15a9266d. Supersedes the eval-only vanilla/center_ph run at s10-snpp-3f15a9266d-da3-222d4a3 (raytun3r blocked there by issue #26). #26's fix (organized@72c9f0d) unblocked this; re-check (pytest green + controlled checkpointing A/B) commented on #26 before this ran.
protocol: fit: 30 three-frame windows, stride 10, 3000 iters, Adam lr 1e-3, clip 1.0, seed 0 (same protocol as the vggt/pi3 rows in *-222d4a3). eval: full sequence, stride 10, 100 windows, methods vanilla+center_ph+raytun3r
commands: python -m raytun3r.train --backbone da3 --variant small --weights pretrained --dataset scannetpp --path <scannetpp>/3f15a9266d --stride 10 --windows 30 --iters 3000 --seed 0 --device cuda:0 --out runs/rt3r/3f15-da3-fit

python -m raytun3r.eval --backbone da3 --variant small --weights pretrained --dataset scannetpp --path <scannetpp>/3f15a9266d --adapter runs/rt3r/3f15-da3-fit/adapter.pt --stride 10 --device cuda:0 --methods vanilla,center_ph,raytun3r --out runs/rt3r/3f15-da3-s10.json
read: raytun3r improves AbsRel, delta_1.25 and t_deg over both vanilla and center_ph, but its R_deg (1.843) is marginally worse than center_ph's (1.786) on this backbone -- the row does not uniformly rank raytun3r first the way the paper's DA3-analog backbones do. See the stride-60 table (s60-3f15a9266d-9cb7410/) for the paper-protocol comparison on VGGT/pi3.
